words.tr:
n. 刷子；灌木丛；
v. 刷；
words.ex: He cleaned the floor with a brush.
words.ex_cn: 他用刷子打扫了地板。
words.en: A brush is an object with a handle and a large number of bristles, hairs, or wires fixed to it, used for cleaning, painting, or arranging hair.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: The teacher chose an arbitrary number to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师随意选了一个数字来开始游戏。
words.en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.ex: He failed the test, but subsequent efforts helped him pass.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，但随后的努力让他通过了。
words.en: Following in time or order; succeeding.

words.ex: He believed his fate was to become a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己的命运是成为一名教师。
words.en: Fate is a power that is believed to control what happens in the future.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.ex: The king's greed led to his downfall.
words.ex_cn: 国王的贪婪导致了他的没落。
words.en: The collapse of a person or organization's power, status, or success.

words.ex: He found employment after graduating from university.
words.ex_cn: 他大学毕业后找到了工作。
words.en: the condition of having paid work

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.ex: His actions are arrestable under the new law.
words.ex_cn: 根据新法律，他的行为是可逮捕的。
words.en: Capable of being arrested, especially by legal authority.

words.ex: His rude words were an offense to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话冒犯了所有人。
words.en: An offense is a crime or a violation of the law; it can also refer to a feeling of being upset or annoyed by something perceived as insulting or disrespectful.

words.tr: phrase. 严肃的面容；不笑或不露情绪的表情
words.ex: She managed to keep a straight face while telling the joke.
words.ex_cn: 她在讲笑话时设法保持了面无表情。
words.en: A straight face is a facial expression that does not show any emotion, especially when you are trying not to laugh or show that you are amused.

words.tr: adj. 琐碎的；微不足道的；心胸狭窄的
words.ex: He got angry over a petty mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一个微不足道的错误生气了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as petty, you mean that they care too much about small, unimportant things and perhaps that they are unnecessarily unkind.

words.ex: The package arrived at my doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 包裹送到我家门口了。
words.en: A doorstep is a step in front of an outer door to a building.

words.tr: n. 反主流文化；反正统文化
words.ex: The 1960s had a strong counterculture that rejected traditional values.
words.ex_cn: 20世纪60年代有一种强烈的反主流文化，拒绝传统价值观。
words.en: A counterculture is a way of life and set of attitudes that are deliberately different from those of the majority of society.

words.tr: adj. 不关心的；漠视的；不相干的
words.ex: He was unconcerned about the noise.
words.ex_cn: 他对噪音毫不在意。
words.en: If you are unconcerned about something, you are not interested in it or worried about it.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: He speaks in a conversational tone with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友说话时用会话式的语调。
words.en: Relating to or in the style of a conversation; informal and friendly.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: His belief in honesty never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对诚实的信念从未改变。
words.en: A belief is a strong feeling that something is true or exists.

words.ex: He cleaned the room thoroughly.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底地打扫了房间。
words.en: In a thorough manner; completely and carefully.

words.tr: adj. 彻底的；完全的；详尽的；
words.ex: He did a thorough cleaning of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他对房子进行了彻底的清洁。
words.en: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

words.tr: adj. 声名狼藉的；名誉不好的
words.ex: He works for a disreputable company.
words.ex_cn: 他为一家声誉不佳的公司工作。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is disreputable, you mean that they have a bad reputation because they are connected with activities that are not considered respectable.

words.ex: He gave up worldly pleasures to live a simple life.
words.ex_cn: 他放弃了世俗的享乐，过着简朴的生活。
words.en: Worldly means relating to the world and the practical matters of life, rather than to spiritual or religious matters.

words.tr: phrase. 熟悉的；精通的；了解内情的
words.ex: She is always au fait with the latest fashion trends.
words.ex_cn: 她总是对最新的时尚潮流了如指掌。
words.en: If you are au fait with a particular subject, you are familiar with it and know about it in detail.

words.ex: Aha! I found my keys!
words.ex_cn: 啊哈！我找到我的钥匙了！
words.en: An exclamation expressing surprise, triumph, or satisfaction.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.tr: n. 地方法官；治安官；行政官；
words.ex: The magistrate decided the small case quickly.
words.ex_cn: 地方法官迅速裁决了这起小案件。
words.en: A magistrate is an official who acts as a judge in law courts that deal with minor crimes or disputes.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: He hired a solicitor to help with his house sale.
words.ex_cn: 他聘请了一名事务律师来帮助处理他的房屋出售。
words.en: A solicitor is a lawyer who gives legal advice and prepares legal documents, especially in England.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.tr:
n. 奖品；裁定；
v. 授予；
words.ex: He received an award for best student.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳学生奖。
words.en: An award is a prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: He earned a respectable salary last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年挣了一份可观的薪水。
words.en: Someone or something that is respectable is approved of by society and considered to be morally correct.

words.tr: v. 给予；发出；“give”的过去式；
words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: Past tense of give, which means to freely transfer the possession of something to someone.

words.ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的意思不清楚。
words.en: If something is obscure, it is not well known or not easily understood.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.ex: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳转。
words.en: If something revolves or if you revolve something, it moves or turns around a central point or line.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；极好的；明亮的；灿烂的；
words.ex: He gave a brilliant answer to the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这道数学题给出了卓越的回答。
words.en: A brilliant person, idea, or performance is extremely clever or skilful.

words.ex: The judge spoke loudly in the courtroom.
words.ex_cn: 法官在法庭上大声讲话。
words.en: A room in which a court of law is held.

words.tr: adv. 沮丧地；黑暗地；阴沉地
words.ex: She stared gloomily out of the window.
words.ex_cn: 她沮丧地盯着窗外。
words.en: In a manner that shows sadness or depression.

words.tr: adj. 黑暗的；幽暗的；忧郁的；沮丧的
words.ex: The room was gloomy with no windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有窗户，很黑暗。
words.en: If a place is gloomy, it is almost dark so that you cannot see very well. If people are gloomy, they are unhappy and have no hope.

words.ex: She looked at him reproachfully for his careless behavior.
words.ex_cn: 她责备地看着他，因为他的粗心行为。
words.en: In a manner that expresses disapproval or disappointment.

words.tr:
v. 责备；指责
n. 责备；指责
words.ex: She reproached him for being late.
words.ex_cn: 她责备他迟到了。
words.en: To express disapproval or disappointment towards someone because of their actions or behavior.

words.ex: He is presumably at home now.
words.ex_cn: 推测起来，他现在在家。
words.en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: The unfair verdict caused public outrage.
words.ex_cn: 不公正的判决引发了公众的愤怒。
words.en: An outrage is an extremely strong reaction of anger, shock, or indignation.

words.tr: phrase. 将某人告上法庭；对某人提起诉讼
words.ex: She decided to take him to court for breach of contract.
words.ex_cn: 她决定以违约为由对他提起诉讼。
words.en: To initiate legal proceedings against someone.

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.ex: He saves up money to buy a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他存钱买一辆自行车。
words.en: To gradually collect money by saving it, especially for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 慢慢来；不着急；从容不迫地做某事
words.ex: He takes his time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢做作业，不着急。
words.en: To use as much time as one needs, without hurrying.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 有获胜或成功的可能性；有机会
words.ex: If you study hard, you stand a chance of passing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 如果你努力学习，你就有可能通过考试。
words.en: To have a possibility of succeeding or achieving something.

words.ex: The story revolves around a boy who finds a magic stone.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事围绕一个发现魔法石的男孩展开。
words.en: To revolve around something means to have it as the main subject or purpose.

words.ex: He turned against his friend because of a big argument.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一次大争吵而背弃了他的朋友。
words.en: To change from being friendly or supportive to being hostile or opposed to someone or something.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.ex: The cop stopped the car for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 警察因超速拦下了那辆车。
words.en: A cop is a police officer. To cop means to catch or arrest someone.

words.ex: Please inform me when the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 请在会议开始时通知我。
words.en: To inform someone means to tell them about something.

words.ex: The loud noise scared the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something scares you, it frightens or worries you.

words.ex: Don't interfere when I am working.
words.ex_cn: 我工作时不要打扰。
words.en: To interfere means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or hindering progress.

words.ex: He will surrender when he sees the police.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到警察时，他会投降。
words.en: If you surrender, you stop fighting or resisting someone and agree that you have been beaten.

words.ex: I am awaiting the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我正在等公交车。
words.en: If you await someone or something, you wait for them.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: He hired a legal lawyer to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位法律律师来帮助他。
words.en: Relating to the law or to lawyers, or permitted or required by law.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: The meeting was fruitful and solved many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议富有成效，解决了许多问题。
words.en: Producing good or helpful results; productive.

words.ex: This experiment is a paradigm of scientific method.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是科学方法的范例。
words.en: A paradigm is a model or pattern that is considered to be a typical example of something.

words.ex: The limitation of the phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的限制是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A limitation is a rule or situation that restricts what you can do or what can happen.

words.ex: After the crisis, the company decided to refocus its resources on more profitable areas.
words.ex_cn: 危机过后，公司决定将资源重新聚焦于更有利可图的领域。
words.en: If you refocus your attention, energy, or efforts, you adjust your focus so that you can concentrate on something else or on a different aspect of something.

words.ex: The teacher changed the parameter to make the test easier.
words.ex_cn: 老师更改了参数，使测试更容易。
words.en: A parameter is a limit or boundary which defines the scope of a particular process or activity.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: He put sesame on his bread.
words.ex_cn: 他在面包上撒了芝麻。
words.en: Sesame is a plant grown for its seeds, which are used in cooking and for their oil.

words.ex: He eats a strawberry every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗草莓。
words.en: A strawberry is a small red fruit which is soft and juicy and has tiny yellow seeds on its surface.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.tr: n. 纯粹主义者；语言纯正癖者
words.ex: He is a purist who only drinks black coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他是个纯粹主义者，只喝黑咖啡。
words.en: A purist is someone who insists on following traditional rules or styles, especially in the arts, and who believes that these should not be changed or mixed with modern elements.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.ex: He outdid his brother in the math competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中胜过了他的哥哥。
words.en: To outdo someone means to be more successful than them in a particular activity.

words.ex: My sibling plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的兄弟/姐妹每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A sibling is a brother or sister.

words.tr: n. 藤；藤蔓；藤本植物；葡萄藤；
words.ex: The grapes grow on a vine.
words.ex_cn: 葡萄长在藤上。
words.en: A vine is a plant that climbs up or along a support, such as a wall or trellis, and produces fruit or flowers.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: He gave a definite answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了肯定的答案。
words.en: If something is definite, it is firm and clear, and unlikely to be changed.

words.ex: His room is messy with clothes everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很杂乱，衣服到处都是。
words.en: If you describe something as messy, you mean that it is untidy or dirty.

words.tr: v. 重新调整；重新适应
words.ex: He had to readjust his schedule after the meeting was moved.
words.ex_cn: 会议改期后，他不得不重新调整自己的日程。
words.en: To adjust or adapt again, especially to a new situation or environment.

words.ex: He will rename the file tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会重命名这个文件。
words.en: To give a new name to someone or something.

words.ex: The child received vaccination last week.
words.ex_cn: 孩子上周接种了疫苗。
words.en: The act of introducing a vaccine into the body to produce immunity to a specific disease.

words.ex: Smallpox caused many deaths in the past.
words.ex_cn: 天花在过去导致了许多人死亡。
words.en: An acute, highly infectious, often fatal disease caused by a poxvirus and characterized by high fever and aches with subsequent widespread eruption of pimples that blister, produce pus, and form pockmarks.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: The weather is mild today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气温和。
words.en: Mild is used to describe something that is not extreme, severe, or strong, such as weather, taste, or behavior.

words.ex: Smallpox is a highly contagious pox.
words.ex_cn: 天花是一种高度传染性的痘症。
words.en: A pox is a disease characterized by pustules or eruptions on the skin, often associated with viruses.

words.tr: v. 接种疫苗；预防接种
words.ex: The doctor will vaccinate the child tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会给这个孩子接种疫苗。
words.en: To vaccinate someone is to give them a vaccine, usually by injection, to prevent them from getting a disease.

words.ex: We can redefine the rules to make the game more fun.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以重新定义规则，让游戏更有趣。
words.en: To define something again or differently, especially in order to give it a new or improved meaning.

words.tr: v. 给（图片、照片）换框，重新装裱；再构造（图画、照片等）；全新地拟定（或表达）（话语、概念或计划...
words.ex: He decided to reframe the old photo before hanging it on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他决定在把旧照片挂上墙之前给它换一个新相框。
words.en: To reframe something means to change the way it is expressed or considered.

words.tr: n. 练习册；作业本；工作簿
words.ex: He uses a workbook to practice math every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天用练习册练习数学。
words.en: A workbook is a book containing exercises and problems for students to practice and learn from.

words.tr: n. 发明家；发明者；创造者；
words.ex: Thomas Edison was a famous inventor.
words.ex_cn: 托马斯·爱迪生是一位著名的发明家。
words.en: An inventor is a person who has invented something, or whose job is to invent things.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；著名的；
words.ex: This is a notable achievement.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个值得注意的成就。
words.en: Worthy of attention or notice; remarkable.

words.ex: The medicine is potent and works quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物非常有效，起效很快。
words.en: Something that is potent is very effective and powerful.

words.tr: n. 移动装置；转换机构
words.ex: The shifter mechanism in the car was malfunctioning.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的移动装置出现了故障。
words.en: A shifter is a device or mechanism that is used to change the position, direction, or function of something, especially in machinery or vehicles.

words.ex: The teacher will critique the student's essay tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会对学生的作文发表评论。
words.en: A critique is a detailed analysis and assessment of something, especially a literary, philosophical, or political theory.

words.tr: n. 勋爵；主；上帝；统治者；
words.ex: The lord lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位勋爵住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A lord is a man who has a high rank in the nobility, especially in Britain, or a man who has authority or control over others.

words.ex: The note on the fridge is a reminder to buy milk.
words.ex_cn: 冰箱上的便条是提醒买牛奶的东西。
words.en: A reminder is something that makes you think about or remember someone or something else.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.tr:
n. 喧嚷；大声的要求
v. 喧嚷；大声地要求
words.ex: The crowd made a loud clamor for justice.
words.ex_cn: 人群为正义发出大声喧哗。
words.en: If people are clamoring for something, they are demanding it in a noisy or angry way.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: The company's ever-growing demand for resources is straining the supply chain.
words.ex_cn: 公司日益增长的需求正在使供应链紧张。
words.en: Continuously increasing in size, amount, or intensity.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家网上工作。
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.ex: The image was enhanced digitally.
words.ex_cn: 这张图像经过了数字增强。
words.en: In a way that uses or relates to digital technology, especially computers.

words.ex: He uses a digital watch to tell time.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块数字手表看时间。
words.en: Digital systems, devices, or technology use electronic signals that are represented by the numbers 1 and 0, indicating 'on' or 'off'.

words.ex: He uses the web to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网络来查找信息。
words.en: A web is a thin net made from sticky threads that a spider uses to catch insects.

words.ex: I download music from the internet.
words.ex_cn: 我从互联网下载音乐。
words.en: To download data means to transfer it to your computer or device from another computer or from the internet.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: The light turned on instantaneously.
words.ex_cn: 灯立刻亮了。
words.en: Something that happens instantaneously happens very quickly and without any delay.

words.ex: The car stopped in an instantaneous moment.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在瞬间停了下来。
words.en: Happening or done immediately.

words.ex: He ate a super big pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块超大的披萨。
words.en: If you describe something as super, you mean that it is very good indeed.

words.ex: The car drove fast on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在高速公路上开得很快。
words.en: A highway is a main road, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.ex: I looked everywhere, but my keys are nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 我到处找了，但我的钥匙无处可寻。
words.en: In no place or state; not anywhere.

words.tr: adj. 惊天动地的；极其重大的
words.ex: The discovery was earth-shattering, changing the course of science forever.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现惊天动地，永远改变了科学的发展轨迹。
words.en: Something that is earth-shattering is extremely surprising, important, or impressive.

words.tr: v. 使粉碎；使破碎；使破灭；
words.ex: The stone shattered when it hit the ground.
words.ex_cn: 石头撞到地面时碎裂了。
words.en: If something shatters or is shattered, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.tr:
n. 双关语
v. 说双关语
words.ex: He made a bad pun and everyone groaned.
words.ex_cn: 他开了个蹩脚的玩笑，大家都皱起了眉头。
words.en: A pun is a clever and amusing use of a word or phrase with two meanings, or of words with the same sound but different meanings.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: The detective uncovered the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探揭开了真相。
words.en: To uncover something means to remove the cover from it or to reveal it by investigation or inquiry.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet is a preventive measure.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔是一种预防性的措施。
words.en: Designed to stop something undesirable from occurring.

words.tr: v. （使）调低速档；（使）工作降格，下调职业档次；减慢节奏（以减轻压力）; n. 换低速档；（质量...
words.ex: He downshifted to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他降档以减慢车速。
words.en: To downshift means to change to a lower gear in a vehicle, or to reduce the speed or intensity of an activity.

words.tr: phrase. 拿出；取出；去掉；取得；领到
words.ex: He took out his keys to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他拿出钥匙开门。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to take something with you when you go somewhere.

words.tr: phrase. 想出；构思出（主意、计划等）
words.ex: He can think up new ideas very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他能很快想出新点子。
words.en: To invent or devise something.

words.ex: In short, he likes pizza.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢披萨。
words.en: used to introduce a summary of something that has just been said or to give a brief statement of the main points.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.ex: The administrative office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责管理学校档案。
words.en: Relating to the management of a company, organization, or institution.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.tr: phrase. 增加；提升；加紧；走上前
words.ex: He will step up to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他将挺身而出帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To increase the amount, speed, or intensity of something.

words.tr: adj. 递升的；电压增高的
words.ex: The company implemented a step-up in training programs to enhance employee skills.
words.ex_cn: 公司实施了提升培训计划，以增强员工技能。
words.en: An increase in size, amount, or speed.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: He has a sweaty forehead after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后额头满是汗。
words.en: If something is sweaty, it is covered in sweat or causes sweat.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: The law compels drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律强迫司机系安全带。
words.en: If a situation, a rule, or a person compels you to do something, they force you to do it.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.tr: phrase. 象牙塔（比喻脱离现实、远离世俗纷扰的学术或艺术世界）
words.ex: She lived in an ivory tower, oblivious to the problems of the real world.
words.ex_cn: 她生活在象牙塔中，对现实世界的问题视而不见。
words.en: An ivory tower is a place or situation where people are happily cut off from the rest of the world and its problems.

words.tr: n. 自立；依靠自己；自力更生
words.ex: He learns self-reliance from living alone.
words.ex_cn: 他通过独自生活学会自立。
words.en: Self-reliance is the ability to do things and make decisions by yourself, without needing other people to help you.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.ex: This school has technological labs for students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为学生配备了科技实验室。
words.en: Technological means relating to or involving technology.

words.ex: The corporation sells smartphones worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向全球销售智能手机。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.tr:
adj. 破旧的；精疲力尽的；耗尽的
n. 扼要报告；描述细节；详细情况；缩减
words.ex: The old house is run-down and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子破旧不堪，需要维修。
words.en: In poor physical condition; tired and weak.

words.ex: They will renovate the old house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月将翻新那栋老房子。
words.en: To renovate means to restore something to a good state of repair or to make it as good as new.

words.ex: He will repay the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月会偿还贷款。
words.en: If you repay a loan or a debt, you pay back the money that you owe to the person who you borrowed or took it from.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.ex: He is working on his doctoral thesis in physics.
words.ex_cn: 他正在撰写他的物理学博士论文。
words.en: Relating to or constituting a doctorate.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.tr: v. 学习；“learn”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有学问的；
words.ex: He learned to read when he was five.
words.ex_cn: 他五岁时学会了阅读。
words.en: A learned person has gained a lot of knowledge by studying.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr:
v. 轻推；轻触；劝说；鼓动
n. 轻推；轻触；劝说；鼓动
words.ex: He gave me a nudge to start the project.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻推了我一下，让我开始这个项目。
words.en: If you nudge someone, you push them gently, usually with your elbow, in order to draw their attention to something.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；情谊；团体；联谊会；研究生奖学金
words.ex: They formed a fellowship to work on the project together.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了伙伴关系一起来做这个项目。
words.en: A fellowship is a group of people who join together for a common purpose or interest, or a financial grant given to a scholar to allow them to study or research at an advanced level.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.ex: He fought for civil rights in the 1960s.
words.ex_cn: 他在20世纪60年代为公民权利而斗争。
words.en: The rights of citizens to political and social freedom and equality.

words.ex: I trusted my intuition and chose the right answer.
words.ex_cn: 我相信自己的直觉，选了正确的答案。
words.en: Intuition is the ability to understand or know something immediately, without the need for conscious reasoning.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.tr:
n. 火花；火星；
v. 激发；
words.ex: The match produced a small spark.
words.ex_cn: 火柴产生了一个小火花。
words.en: A spark is a small fiery particle thrown off from a fire, alight in ashes, or produced by striking together two hard surfaces such as stone or metal.

words.ex: The dirt pathway led to the small house.
words.ex_cn: 这条土路通向那座小房子。
words.en: A pathway is a track that is made by or for people walking, especially one through a countryside or a park.

words.tr:
n. 魔术；魔法；
adj. 魔术（似）的；神奇的；
words.ex: He performed magic at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上表演了魔术。
words.en: Magic is the power to use supernatural forces to make impossible things happen, such as making people disappear or controlling events in nature.

words.ex: He stays up late to watch movies.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜看电影。
words.en: To remain awake and not go to bed.

words.ex: He takes notes during the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时做笔记。
words.en: To write down information, especially during a lecture or meeting, in order to remember it later.

words.tr: phrase. 建立于；以…为基础；指望
words.ex: He built on his old ideas to make a new plan.
words.ex_cn: 他基于旧的想法制定了一个新计划。
words.en: To develop or increase something from a particular starting point or base.

words.ex: She keeps a diary every night before bed.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上睡觉前都写日记。
words.en: To regularly record personal experiences, thoughts, or feelings in a diary.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 送行；寄出；解雇；（足球中）罚下场
words.ex: The company held a ceremony to send off the retiring CEO.
words.ex_cn: 公司为即将退休的CEO举行了一场送别仪式。
words.en: To dispatch someone or something to a destination, or to bid farewell to someone who is leaving.

words.tr: 短语动词. 恢复呼吸；歇一口气；（因惊讶或激动）屏住呼吸
words.ex: He stopped to catch his breath after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完后停下来喘口气。
words.en: To pause and rest after physical exertion in order to regain normal breathing.

words.tr:
n. 曲柄；怪人；脾气坏的人
v. 用曲柄转动
adj. 古怪的；易怒的
words.ex: He turns the crank to start the old engine.
words.ex_cn: 他转动曲柄来启动旧引擎。
words.en: A crank is a device for transmitting rotary motion, consisting of a handle or arm attached at right angles to a shaft. It can also refer to a person who holds unorthodox opinions or behaves in an eccentric manner.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.ex: The weather today is nasty and rainy.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气令人不愉快，又阴又雨。
words.en: If you describe something as nasty, you mean it is very unpleasant, unattractive, or unkind.

words.ex: He called his friend an idiot after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他在犯错后称朋友是白痴。
words.en: An idiot is a person who is considered to be very stupid or foolish.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.tr:
v. 经营；跑步；
n. 运转；跑；
words.ex: He runs a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家小咖啡馆。
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: He plays baseball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打棒球。
words.en: a game played especially in North America by two teams of nine players, in which a player hits a ball with a bat and tries to run around four bases on a large field before the other team returns the ball

words.ex: The editorialist criticized the government's new policy in the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 这位主笔在报纸上批评了政府的新政策。
words.en: An editorialist is a person who writes editorials, which are articles in a newspaper or magazine that give the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic of current interest.

words.tr: n. [语] 拼错; v. [语] 拼错（misspell 的现在分词）
words.ex: The teacher pointed out the misspelling in the student's essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师指出了学生文章中的拼写错误。
words.en: A misspelling is a mistake made in the spelling of a word.

words.tr: adj. 多虱的；可鄙的；差劲的
words.ex: The dog had a lousy coat full of fleas.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的毛发多虱子。
words.en: If you describe something as lousy, you mean that it is of very bad quality or that you do not like it.

words.ex: She is a fast typist.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位打字很快的打字员。
words.en: A typist is someone who types, especially as their job.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.tr:
n. 残疾；障碍；阻碍；不利
v. 妨碍；使不利
words.ex: He has a physical handicap but still runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有身体残疾，但仍然每天跑步。
words.en: A handicap is a condition that markedly restricts a person's ability to function physically, mentally, or socially.

words.tr:
adj. 有生理缺陷的；残疾的；弱智的
v. 妨碍；使不利；“handicap”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The school made the playground accessible for handicapped children.
words.ex_cn: 学校让操场方便残障儿童使用。
words.en: A handicapped person has a physical or mental disability.

words.tr:
v. 把…联系在一起；
adj. 副的；
n. 同事；伙伴；
words.ex: He associates happiness with family time.
words.ex_cn: 他把幸福与家庭时光联系在一起。
words.en: If you associate someone or something with a particular quality or idea, or if they are associated with it, you connect them in your mind with that quality or idea.

words.tr:
n. 社论；
adj. 编辑的；
words.ex: The newspaper published an editorial about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 报纸发表了一篇关于气候变化的社论。
words.en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic or item of news.

words.tr:
v. 点击；
n. 咔哒声；
words.ex: Click the button to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 点击按钮开始游戏。
words.en: To make a short, sharp sound, or to press a button on a computer mouse or other device to select something on a screen.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.tr: n. 留言板；访客留言簿
words.ex: Visitors can leave their comments in the guestbook.
words.ex_cn: 访客可以在留言簿上留下他们的评论。
words.en: A book in which visitors to a public building, such as a museum or a church, can write their names and sometimes a message or comment.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.ex: She has traveled extensively across Europe.
words.ex_cn: 她广泛地游历了欧洲。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide range of details, ideas, or items.

words.tr: n. 读者（数）；高级讲师职位
words.ex: The newspaper has a large readership.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸拥有大量的读者。
words.en: The number or type of people who read a particular newspaper, magazine, or book.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.ex: The cost is $5 per hour.
words.ex_cn: 每小时费用是5美元。
words.en: Used to express the rate at which something happens or the means by which something is done.

words.ex: The teacher used a pointer to show the map on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一根指物棒指着墙上的地图。
words.en: A pointer is a piece of advice or information which helps you to understand a situation or to find a way of making progress.

words.ex: His dedication to teaching helped many students succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他对教学的奉献帮助了许多学生取得成功。
words.en: The act of dedicating or the state of being dedicated; commitment.

words.ex: He dedicates his time to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you dedicate yourself to something, you give all your attention and effort to it.

words.tr: n. 归档；存档； v. 把…归档；“file”的现在分词；
words.ex: The office needs better filing for old documents.
words.ex_cn: 办公室需要更好的归档系统来存放旧文件。
words.en: The act of putting documents into a file or the material removed by filing.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.tr: n. 伤残；失去能力；无能力；
words.ex: He has a disability that makes walking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 他有伤残，导致行走困难。
words.en: A disability is a physical or mental condition that limits a person's movements, senses, or activities.

words.tr:
adj. 精心制作的；详尽的；
v. 精心制作；详尽阐述；
words.ex: She wore an elaborate dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件精心制作的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: To elaborate means to add more details to something that has already been said or written, making it more complex or detailed. As an adjective, it describes something that is very complex and detailed.

words.tr:
n. 骗局；恶作剧；戏弄
v. 愚弄
words.ex: The news was a hoax to scare people.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻是个骗局，为了吓唬人。
words.en: A hoax is a plan to deceive someone, such as telling the police there is a bomb somewhere when there is not, or a trick in which someone tells people a lie.

words.tr:
adj. 男性的；雄性的；
n. 男性；雄性；
words.ex: The male bird has bright red feathers.
words.ex_cn: 这只雄鸟有鲜艳的红色羽毛。
words.en: A male is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that cannot have babies. In humans, males are usually considered to be boys or men.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了漏水的管道。
words.en: A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

words.ex: The cerebral cortex controls thinking and memory.
words.ex_cn: 大脑皮层控制思考和记忆。
words.en: Relating to the brain or the intellect.

words.ex: He has palsy in his right hand.
words.ex_cn: 他的右手有麻痹。
words.en: Palsy is a condition marked by uncontrollable tremor or paralysis of a part of the body.

words.tr: phrase. 脑性瘫痪；一种由于大脑发育异常或受损导致的运动障碍疾病
words.ex: He has cerebral palsy and walks with help.
words.ex_cn: 他患有脑瘫，走路需要帮助。
words.en: A condition marked by impaired muscle coordination (spastic paralysis) and/or other disabilities, typically caused by damage to the brain before or at birth.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.tr: n. 马达；发动机；机动车；
words.ex: The car has a strong motor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强大的马达。
words.en: A motor is a device that changes energy into mechanical motion, especially such a device that provides power for a vehicle or for another device with moving parts.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.tr:
n. 大学；校队
adj. 大学代表队的
words.ex: He plays football for varsity.
words.ex_cn: 他为大学足球队打球。
words.en: A varsity is the principal team representing a university, college, or school in sports, games, or other competitions.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: The statistician analyzed the survey data.
words.ex_cn: 这位统计学家分析了调查数据。
words.en: A statistician is a person who specializes in the study and interpretation of numerical data, especially in order to make predictions or inferences about a population or a process.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.tr: adj. 所谓的；假定的； v. 认定；假设；“suppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is the supposed expert on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 他是所谓的古代史专家。
words.en: If you say that something is supposed to be true, you mean that people say it is true but you do not know whether it is definitely true.

words.tr: adj. 完全的；荒凉的；光秃秃的；僵硬的；严厉的
words.ex: There was a stark difference between the two results.
words.ex_cn: 这两个结果之间有完全的差异。
words.en: Stark means complete, severe, or obvious in a way that is impossible to avoid noticing.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

words.ex: He washed his hands to remove the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他洗手以去除污垢。
words.en: Dirt is any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust.

words.ex: He drew a dot on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个小圆点。
words.en: A dot is a very small round mark, for example one that is used as the top part of the letter 'i', as a full stop, or as a decimal point.

words.ex: The car hit a big pothole on the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路上撞到了一个大坑。
words.en: A pothole is a large hole in the surface of a road, caused by traffic and bad weather.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.tr: n. 简陋的小屋；水手号子；
words.ex: The fishermen lived in a small shanty by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔民们住在海边的一间简陋小屋里。
words.en: A shanty is a small, crudely built shack or a sailor's work song.

words.ex: The trees surround the house.
words.ex_cn: 树木环绕着房子。
words.en: If something or someone is surrounded by something, that thing is situated all around them.

words.tr: n. 废旧杂物；无价值的东西；
words.ex: He cleaned up the junk in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他清理了车库里那些废旧杂物。
words.en: Old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: She curls her hair every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上卷头发。
words.en: To form into a spiral or curved shape; a piece of hair that grows in a curved shape.

words.ex: He uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅来移动。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, injury, or disability.

words.ex: The child hurt his limb while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时伤到了肢体。
words.en: A limb is one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.tr:
n. 黑暗；忧郁；幽暗
v. 变阴暗；变忧郁
words.ex: The room was filled with gloom after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间里一片黑暗。
words.en: Gloom is a feeling of sadness and lack of hope.

words.tr:
n. 击球员；
v. 连续猛击；
words.ex: The batter hit a home run in the ninth inning.
words.ex_cn: 击球员在第九局击出了全垒打。
words.en: To batter something means to hit it hard many times, often causing a lot of damage. In sports, a batter is the player who is trying to hit the ball in games like baseball or cricket. Batter can also refer to a mixture of flour, eggs, and milk or water, used to make pancakes or to coat food before frying.

words.ex: He sat on the couch and watched TV.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在沙发上看电视。
words.en: A couch is a long, comfortable seat for two or more people to sit on. It is also used to refer to a piece of furniture designed for lying down or sleeping.

words.tr: adj. 布满蜘蛛网的; v. 使布满蛛网（cobweb 的过去式）
words.ex: The old attic was cobwebbed and dusty.
words.ex_cn: 旧阁楼布满蜘蛛网，满是灰尘。
words.en: Covered with cobwebs; old and unused.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.ex: The children played near the cinder pile after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在火堆后的煤渣堆旁玩耍。
words.en: A cinder is a small piece of partly burnt coal or wood that has stopped giving off flames but still has combustible matter in it.

words.tr: phrase. 煤渣砖；一种用煤渣和水泥制成的建筑用空心砖
words.ex: The foundation of the shed was built using cinder blocks.
words.ex_cn: 小屋的地基是用煤渣砖建造的。
words.en: A cinder block is a large, rectangular building block made from concrete and coal cinders, used in construction.

words.ex: He will fasten his seatbelt before driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车前会系好安全带。
words.en: To close or attach something firmly so that it will not open or come loose.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.tr:
adj. 精瘦的；精简的；不景气的；
v. 倾斜；倚靠；
words.ex: The dog is lean and fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗精瘦而敏捷。
words.en: If you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction. If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy. If you describe a period of time as lean, you mean that it is a time when people have very little of something, especially money.

words.tr:
v. 啄；连续敲击；轻吻
n. 啄痕；啄食；轻吻
words.ex: The bird pecked at the bread on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿啄地上的面包。
words.en: To peck means to strike or bite something with the beak, or to kiss someone lightly and quickly.

words.tr:
v. 咯咯地笑
n. 咯咯笑；趣事
words.ex: The children giggle when they see the clown.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到小丑时咯咯笑。
words.en: To laugh in a silly, often high-pitched way, especially in a nervous or embarrassed manner.

words.tr: n. 犬儒主义；愤世嫉俗；玩世不恭
words.ex: He showed cynicism about politicians' promises.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治家的承诺表现出愤世嫉俗。
words.en: Cynicism is the belief that people are motivated purely by self-interest rather than acting for honorable or unselfish reasons.

words.tr: adj. 愤世嫉俗的；悲观的；
words.ex: He gave a cynical smile when they talked about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 当他们谈到诚实时，他露出了愤世嫉俗的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as cynical, you mean they believe that people always act selfishly.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.tr: phrase. 责备某人；训斥某人
words.ex: The teacher took the student to task for not completing the homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为学生没有完成作业而责备了他。
words.en: To criticize or reprimand someone for something they have done wrong.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.tr: phrase. 引起某人的注意；吸引某人的眼球
words.ex_cn: 广告的鲜艳色彩设计是为了引人注目。
words.en: To attract someone's attention.

words.tr: phrase. 怀着……的希望；期望；以期
words.ex: He studies hard in hopes of passing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，希望能通过考试。
words.en: With the expectation or desire that something will happen.

words.tr: phrase. 怀着……的希望；期望能够；以期
words.ex: He waited outside the house in the hope of seeing her.
words.ex_cn: 他在房子外面等着，希望能见到她。
words.en: with the desire or expectation that something will happen

words.tr: phrase. 那又怎样；有什么了不起（用于表示不关心或轻蔑）
words.ex: So what if it's raining? We can still go out.
words.ex_cn: 那又怎样，下雨了？我们仍然可以出去。
words.en: An expression used to dismiss something as unimportant or to challenge the significance of a statement.

words.ex: He is sort of tired after the long walk.
words.ex_cn: 他走了很长的路，有几分累了。
words.en: to some extent; rather

words.tr: phrase. 穿过；抄近路走过；切断；刺穿
words.ex: He cut through the forest to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过森林以节省时间。
words.en: To go through or across something, especially in a direct or efficient way.

words.tr: phrase. 蜷缩；卷起；使弯曲成团
words.ex: The cat likes to curl up on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢蜷缩在沙发上。
words.en: To assume a position with the legs drawn up and the back rounded, often for warmth or comfort.

words.tr: phrase. 给…打电话；使想起；召集
words.ex: He called up his friend to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友打电话问好。
words.en: To telephone someone; to summon someone to military service; to bring something back to one's mind.

words.ex: The new rules add to the cost.
words.ex_cn: 新规定增加了成本。
words.en: To increase or enhance something by adding more to it.

words.ex: The song brings back happy memories.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌唤起了快乐的回忆。
words.en: To bring something back means to return it to the place where it was before, or to make it exist or happen again.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.tr:
v. 把…塞进狭窄的空间；把…藏入
n. 褶皱；零食
words.ex: He tucked the letter into his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把信塞进了口袋里。
words.en: If you tuck something somewhere, you put it there so that it is safe, comfortable, or neat.

words.tr: adj. 一定会；密切相关的；有义务的； v. “bind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is bound to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他一定会赢得比赛。
words.en: If one person, thing, or situation is bound to another, they are closely connected with each other, and it is difficult for them to be separated or to escape from each other. If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.

words.ex: He flipped the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子快速翻转了煎饼。
words.en: To flip something means to turn it over quickly one or more times, or to make something do this.

words.ex: The stillness of the night was broken by a sudden cry.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的沉静被一声突如其来的叫喊打破。
words.en: The absence of movement or sound; quietness and calm.

words.ex: The child felt helpless when he lost his mother.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子失去妈妈时，他感到无助。
words.en: Unable to defend oneself or to act without help.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.ex: He works on a large ranch in Texas.
words.ex_cn: 他在德克萨斯州的一个大牧场工作。
words.en: A ranch is a large farm, especially in the western United States and Canada, where cattle or other animals are bred and raised.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.tr: phrase. 日间托儿所；日托中心
words.ex: She dropped her child off at the day nursery before going to work.
words.ex_cn: 她上班前把孩子送到托儿所。
words.en: A day nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: They maintain correspondence through letters.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过信件保持通信联系。
words.en: Communication by exchanging letters with someone; a close similarity, connection, or equivalence.

words.ex: He takes a correspondence course to learn English at home.
words.ex_cn: 他通过函授课程在家学习英语。
words.en: A course of study in which student and tutors communicate by post.

words.ex: He formally accepted the award at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上正式接受了奖项。
words.en: in a formal manner

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.tr: v. 使合格；使具有资格；
words.ex: He studied hard to qualify for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以获得这份工作的资格。
words.en: To qualify means to meet the necessary conditions or standards to be eligible for something or to perform a particular role.

words.ex: His enrolment at the university starts next month.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的入学时间是下个月。
words.en: Enrolment refers to the process of signing up or registering for something, such as a school, course, or program.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.ex: She was frantic to catch the last bus.
words.ex_cn: 她急忙赶着赶最后一班公交车。
words.en: If someone is frantic, they are behaving in a wild and desperate way, often because they are frightened or worried.

words.tr: adj. 全部时间的；专任的
words.ex: He works full-time at a grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家杂货店全职工作。
words.en: If you are a full-time worker, you work the normal number of hours or days in a week.

words.ex: He skipped the hard question and moved to the next one.
words.ex_cn: 他略过了难题，继续做下一题。
words.en: To move lightly and quickly, making a small jump after each step.

words.ex: He types fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他打字很快，用的是键盘。
words.en: A keyboard is a panel of keys that operate a computer or typewriter.

words.tr: adj. 狂喜的；欣喜若狂的
words.ex: She was ecstatic when she won the prize.
words.ex_cn: 她赢得奖品时欣喜若狂。
words.en: If you are ecstatic, you feel very happy and full of excitement.

words.tr: v. 吸引；"draw"的过去分词；画；拉；提取；“draw”的过去分词；
words.ex: The bright colors drawn the children's attention.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引了孩子们的注意。
words.en: If someone looks drawn, their face is thin and they look very tired, ill, worried, or unhappy.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.ex: My dad cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我爸爸每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A father; a male parent.

words.ex: Paint the wall evenly.
words.ex_cn: 均匀地刷墙。
words.en: In a manner that is equal, uniform, or balanced.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: He felt embarrassment when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前绊倒时感到窘迫。
words.en: A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.tr:
v. 呜咽；抽噎
n. 抽噎（声）；啜泣（声）
words.ex: The little girl sobbed after losing her toy.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在丢失玩具后哭了起来。
words.en: To cry noisily, taking in short breaths.

words.tr:
n. 架子；支架；齿条；破坏
v. 折磨；使痛苦；放在架上；累计（得分）
words.ex: He put the books on the rack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on. As a verb, to rack something means to cause great pain or suffering to someone.

words.ex: The system has a vulnerability that hackers can exploit.
words.ex_cn: 这个系统有一个黑客可以利用的脆弱性。
words.en: The state of being exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

words.tr: phrase. 干货；纺织品（尤指布料、服装等）
words.ex: The store specializes in dry goods such as fabrics and yarns.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店专门经营纺织品和纱线等干货。
words.en: Dry goods are products such as food, cloth, and other items that are not liquid or frozen.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.tr: n. 纪念品；用以回忆的东西
words.ex: She keeps a photo as a memento of her trip.
words.ex_cn: 她保留了一张照片作为旅行的纪念品。
words.en: A memento is an object which you keep because it reminds you of a person or a special event.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.tr: adj. 古怪的；暴躁的；有毛病的
words.ex: He is cranky when he doesn't sleep well.
words.ex_cn: 他睡眠不好时会脾气暴躁。
words.en: If you describe someone as cranky, you mean they are bad-tempered and irritable.

words.tr: 短语动词. 独自拥有某物；独自享用某物
words.ex: She likes to have the whole beach to herself in the early morning.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢在清晨独自拥有整个海滩。
words.en: To have something for one's own use or enjoyment, without sharing it with others.

words.ex: He is at work right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在工作。
words.en: If someone is at work, they are doing their job or are busy doing a particular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；明白；变得流行
words.ex: He didn't understand the joke at first, but then he caught on.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始没明白这个笑话，但后来明白了。
words.en: To understand or become popular.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 理解，明白；开始流行，变得受欢迎
words.ex: It took her a while to catch on to the new software.
words.ex_cn: 她花了一段时间才掌握这个新软件。
words.en: To understand or realize something, especially after some initial difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 阻碍某人；挡某人的路
words.ex: If you want to pursue your dreams, nothing should stand in your way.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想追求梦想，没有什么应该妨碍你。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or making progress.

words.tr: phrase. 挡某人的路；妨碍某人
words.ex: If you're in my way, I'll have to ask you to move.
words.ex_cn: 如果你挡了我的路，我只好请你让开。
words.en: To be in someone's way means to be in a position that prevents them from moving freely or doing something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 邮购；写信索取
words.ex: We decided to send away for some samples of the new product.
words.ex_cn: 我们决定通过邮寄索取一些新产品的样品。
words.en: To request something to be sent to you by mail.

words.tr: phrase. 用完；耗尽；跑出去；到期
words.ex: We run out of milk every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每星期天都把牛奶喝光了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.ex: He helps out at the store after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在商店帮忙。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something or in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 警惕的；提防的；站岗的；戒备着的
words.ex: The soldier is on guard at the gate.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在门口站岗。
words.en: Being on guard means being watchful and alert to danger or trouble.

words.ex: She left the room in tears after hearing the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 听到坏消息后，她流着泪离开了房间。
words.en: Crying or weeping, often as a result of sadness, pain, or strong emotion.

words.ex: He goes on talking even when no one listens.
words.ex_cn: 即使没人听，他还是继续说。
words.en: To continue an activity or process, especially after a pause or interruption.

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.ex: He shivered in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 他在寒风中哆嗦。
words.en: If you shiver, your body shakes slightly because you are cold or frightened.

words.ex: He felt miserable after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you are miserable, you are very unhappy.

words.ex: He took a capsule for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒胶囊来缓解头痛。
words.en: A capsule is a small container or case, especially one that is sealed and contains a dose of medicine, or a spacecraft's compartment for astronauts.

words.tr:
adj. 通便的
n. 泻药
words.ex: The doctor gave him a purgative to clean his stomach.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他服用了一种泻药来清理肠胃。
words.en: A purgative is a substance that causes you to empty your bowels, often because you are constipated.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.ex: Washing hands can kill germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死病菌。
words.en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

words.ex: He caught influenza last winter.
words.ex_cn: 他去年冬天得了流感。
words.en: Influenza is an infectious disease caused by the influenza virus, characterized by fever, sore throat, muscle pain, severe headache, coughing, and weakness.

words.ex: The epidemic spread quickly across the country.
words.ex_cn: 这种流行病迅速蔓延到全国。
words.en: An epidemic is a large number of cases of an infectious disease occurring at the same time.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.ex: He got pneumonia after a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他得了重感冒后患了肺炎。
words.en: Pneumonia is a serious disease which affects your lungs and makes it difficult for you to breathe.

words.tr: adj. 分离的； v. 脱离；拆卸；分离；“detach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is detached from the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子与邻居的房子是分开的。
words.en: If someone is detached, they do not have any emotional interest in a situation and therefore can make fair decisions.

words.ex: He tried to detach himself from the group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图脱离这个群体。
words.en: If you detach one thing from another that it is fixed to, you remove it. If one thing detaches from another, it becomes separated from it.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.ex: Papa is cooking breakfast for us.
words.ex_cn: 爸爸正在为我们做早餐。
words.en: A term of endearment for one's father.

words.tr: adj. 头昏眼花的；三心二意的；无知的；轻浮的
words.ex: She felt lightheaded after standing up too quickly.
words.ex_cn: 她站起来太快后感到头昏眼花。
words.en: If you feel lightheaded, you feel slightly unsteady and weak, and feel that you may fall over, because you are ill, or because you are shocked or excited.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了治疗感冒的药。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.tr:
n. 雨夹雪
v. 下雨夹雪；下冰雹
words.ex: The road was slippery after a night of sleet.
words.ex_cn: 经过一夜的冻雨，路面变得很滑。
words.en: Sleet is a form of precipitation consisting of ice pellets, often mixed with rain or snow.

words.tr:
n. 刷子；灌木丛；
v. 刷；
words.ex: He cleaned the floor with a brush.
words.ex_cn: 他用刷子打扫了地板。
words.en: A brush is an object with a handle and a large number of bristles, hairs, or wires fixed to it, used for cleaning, painting, or arranging hair.

words.tr:
n. 清漆；漆面；光泽面
v. 给…涂上清漆
words.ex: He put varnish on the wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 他在木桌上涂了清漆。
words.en: Varnish is a transparent, hard, protective finish or film primarily used in wood finishing but also for other materials. Varnish is traditionally a combination of a drying oil, a resin, and a thinner or solvent.

words.ex: She loves Irish music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢爱尔兰音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Irish means belonging or relating to Ireland, or to its people, language, or culture.

words.tr: n. 制定者；塞特种猎犬
words.ex: He is the setter of new rules for the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是团队新规则的制定者。
words.en: A setter is a person or thing that sets something, especially a type of dog trained to find and indicate the position of game birds.

words.ex: The children played near the creek after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在小河旁玩耍。
words.en: A creek is a small, narrow stream or river.

words.tr: adj. 像玻璃的；光滑的；呆滞的
words.ex: The lake surface looked glassy in the morning light.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的阳光下，湖面像玻璃一样平静。
words.en: Resembling glass, as in smoothness, transparency, or brittleness.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.ex: The snake slithered through the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蛇在草丛中滑行。
words.en: To move smoothly and quietly with a twisting or oscillating motion, like a snake.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.ex: He flushes the toilet after using it.
words.ex_cn: 他用完厕所后冲水。
words.en: If you flush, your face goes red because you are hot or ill, or because you are feeling a strong emotion such as embarrassment or anger. To flush a toilet means to cause water to pass through it in order to clean it.

words.tr: n. 一队；一群; n. （Covey）人名；（英）科维
words.ex: A covey of partridges rose from the underbrush.
words.ex_cn: 一队鹧鸪从灌木丛中飞起。
words.en: A covey is a small group of birds, especially partridges or quails.

words.tr:
n. 鹌鹑；鹌鹑肉 
v. 畏缩；胆怯
words.ex: The farmer raised quail for their eggs.
words.ex_cn: 农夫饲养鹌鹑来获取它们的蛋。
words.en: If someone quails, they feel or show fear or hesitation.

words.tr:
n. 外伸量；
v. 向…伸出；
words.ex: The roof has an overhang of one meter.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶有一个一米的外伸量。
words.en: If something overhangs a place or object, it sticks out over and above it.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.ex: The wind scatter the leaves everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 风把树叶吹得四处分散。
words.en: To scatter means to throw or drop things over a wide area in an irregular way, or to cause a group of people or animals to move apart in different directions.

words.ex: The children built a mound of sand at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上堆了一个沙土墩。
words.en: A mound is a large pile of earth or stones; it can also refer to the action of piling up earth or stones.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；姿态；镇静
v. 使平衡；保持（某种姿势）
words.ex: The dancer maintained her poise on one foot.
words.ex_cn: 舞者单脚保持平衡。
words.en: If someone has poise, they are calm, dignified, and self-controlled.

words.tr: adv. 不稳定地；摇摆地（unsteady 的副词）; vt. 使不稳定
words.ex: He walked unsteadily after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他走路摇摇晃晃。
words.en: In a manner that is not steady or stable; with a tendency to wobble or shake.

words.tr: adj. 不稳的；动摇不定的；不规则的
words.ex: He walked in an unsteady way after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 他喝酒后走路不稳。
words.en: If you describe something as unsteady, you mean that it is not firm or stable, and seems likely to change, move, or collapse.

words.ex: Her icy smile made him feel cold.
words.ex_cn: 她冰冷的微笑让他感到寒意。
words.en: If you describe something as icy, you mean that it is extremely cold.

words.ex: She had a springy step, full of energy.
words.ex_cn: 她步伐轻快，充满活力。
words.en: Something that is springy is flexible and returns to its original shape after being pressed or stretched.

words.ex: The class will commence at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程将在上午9点开始。
words.en: To begin something; to start.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.tr:
n. 凝视；注视；
v. 凝视；注视；
words.ex: His gaze fixed on the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他的凝视固定在日落上。
words.en: If you gaze at someone or something, you look steadily at them for a long time, for example because you find them attractive or interesting, or because you are thinking about something else.

words.ex: The rope is slack and hangs loosely.
words.ex_cn: 绳子是松弛的，垂挂着。
words.en: If something is slack, it is loose and not firmly stretched or tightly in position. It can also describe a period of low activity or a lack of effort in work or activity.

words.ex: The new policy will bring down prices.
words.ex_cn: 新政策将降低价格。
words.en: To cause something to fall or collapse; to reduce the level or amount of something; to cause someone in a position of power to lose their position.

words.tr: adj. 分离的； v. 脱离；拆卸；分离；“detach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is detached from the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子与邻居的房子是分开的。
words.en: If someone is detached, they do not have any emotional interest in a situation and therefore can make fair decisions.

words.tr: phrase. 看不见；在视野以外
words.ex: The keys are out of sight under the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在沙发下面，看不见了。
words.en: If something is out of sight, it is too far away to be seen.

words.ex: He tried to keep from crying.
words.ex_cn: 他努力忍住不哭。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or to not do something oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 放轻松；别紧张；悠着点
words.ex: Take it easy, the test is not hard.
words.ex_cn: 别紧张，考试不难。
words.en: To relax and not do anything too energetic or stressful.

words.tr: 短语动词. 紧紧控制自己的情绪或行为；保持自我克制
words.ex: In the midst of chaos, it's important to hold tight onto oneself and not lose sight of one's values.
words.ex_cn: 在混乱中，重要的是紧紧抓住自己，不迷失自己的价值观。
words.en: To maintain a firm grasp on one's emotions or self-control, especially in challenging situations.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.ex: He analyzes data every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天分析数据。
words.en: To examine something methodically and in detail, typically in order to explain and interpret it.

words.tr:
n. 抓痕；刮伤；
v. 抓搔；刮；
words.ex: The cat left a scratch on the door.
words.ex_cn: 猫在门上抓出了一道抓痕。
words.en: If you scratch something, you rub your fingernails or claws against it, often because it is itchy or irritating.

words.tr:
n. 窝；鸟巢；
v. 筑巢；
words.ex: The bird built a nest in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在树上筑了一个窝。
